import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Standardize species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # Standardize island label variants (e.g., lower-case 'biscoe')
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Convert body_mass_g from text (possible commas) to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''))
    # Keep the id column as required
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and compute average body mass
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
